summary: Full regression on v50m vendor profile changes + SEC fixes. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass (profile request CRUD, email verify flow with 412 pre-verify guard, admin approve/reject, DocuSign webhook HMAC fail-closed/accept). Frontend: Admin masters 'Profile changes' tab wired correctly, Account page edit test-ids present, Verify-email page renders error for bogus token, Tenders page renders cards with pagination. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: the Vendor Portal left sidebar <nav class='pmc-lnav'> still renders every link as <a href='#'> — the React Router Link conversion that was the headline fix of this iteration was NOT shipped for the main sidebar. aria-current flipping works (because something imperatively toggles it on route change) but the actual DOM is still the static Option-E mockup markup.

ui_bugs.issue:
CRITICAL — The vendor-portal left sidebar is STILL the static Option-E mockup. All sidebar elements render with href='#' (Home, Find tenders, My bids, EMD & payments, Signatures, Company & KYC, Reviews, Account & security, Help & FAQs). No React Router / is used. The user's exact bug report ('nav items navigate via href=# causing hard reloads') is NOT fixed. Confirmed by evaluating the live DOM: `
...Home...
`. Interestingly aria-current='page' does flip on the correct link when the route changes (so some JS listens to the route) — but the hrefs themselves are hash-only, so Cmd/Ctrl+Click (open in new tab), right-click→copy link, screen-readers announcing destinations, and middle-click will all break.

Mismatch between sidebar badge count and page heading: sidebar shows 'Find tenders 29' but the /vendor/tenders page heading says '17 tenders available'. Either the sidebar badge is pulling a different (older/wider) list than the page query, or the page is filtering out 12 notices without surfacing why. Not a blocking bug but inconsistent to the user.

integration_issues.issue: The 'new value' control in the Request-change dialog is pre-filled with the CURRENT value for address (`New Street 123, Astana, Kazakhstan`). If the user clicks Submit without editing, the backend correctly rejects with 400 'same as current', but the UI treats this as a hard error toast rather than disabling Submit while value===current. Minor UX improvement.

critical_code_review_comments: vendor_profile_changes.py line 161: `email_verified` is set to None for email requests but to True for all other fields — this is deliberate, but the admin list endpoint returns these mixed-type booleans/null raw; frontend badge code needs to handle `== null`, `== true`, `== false` cases.
vendor_profile_changes.py line 183: email-send failure is swallowed silently (`except Exception: pass`). Consider logging to help admin diagnose when the vendor says they never got the mail.
docusign.py _verify_hmac correctly fails-closed in production and warn+accepts in non-prod; implementation looks solid.
server.py line 76 correctly registers vendor_profile_changes BEFORE vendors.router so /vendors/profile-change-requests avoids the /{vendor_ref} catch-all.
Frontend sidebar still ships pre-React static Option-E markup — this is the headline deliverable of v50m and is incomplete.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up several TEST_ADDR_* / email-change requests during pytest. All cycled through approve/reject so DB is clean. Vendor email reverted back to manualvendor@pmcmanagers.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core blocking issue is purely in VendorPortalChrome.jsx — the <nav class='pmc-lnav'> block still uses <a href='#'>. Once that is fixed, re-run the UI test checking: (1) sidebar links render with real routes (not '#'), (2) clicking them does NOT trigger a full page reload (window.performance.navigation / absence of a React remount), (3) aria-current='page' stays correct, (4) sidebar Find-tenders badge count matches /vendor/tenders page heading count. Backend already fully verified by /app/backend/tests/test_v50m_profile_changes.py — just rerun that file to confirm nothing regressed.
rca of the issue: RCA for sidebar href='#' bug: VendorPortalChrome.jsx appears to have been copied verbatim from the Option-E HTML mockup, which hard-codes <a href='#'> because the mockup never had routing. The main agent likely added a route-watching effect that sets aria-current but forgot to swap the <a> tags for <NavLink>. Reproduction: 1) log in as manualvendor@pmcmanagers.com, 2) open DevTools, 3) inspect any item in nav.pmc-lnav — href='#'. Fix: replace each sidebar anchor with <NavLink to='/vendor/tenders' end>...</NavLink> and let NavLink handle both href and aria-current='page' automatically.
